rationale: Health repeatability concepts #2 and #3 proved that exact governed insurance concepts can be recognized while natural customer question shapes still fall to clarification before evidence. Reuse the existing POLICY_FACT_LOOKUP intent and DIRECT_FACT_PLAN by adding a generic fallback for interrogative/conditional questions containing an exact governed concept mention, map that candidate to requested_fact, and allow the already-bound product scope to satisfy policy_or_document_reference. Room-rent customer language additions remain governed terminology data rather than runtime branches.
supersession_impact: No intent label, plan type, planner template, Instance Sufficiency rule, evidence authority, reasoning rule, decision gate, or response authority is replaced. Existing stronger intent rules retain precedence because the fallback runs only when no governed rule matches. Analyzer behavior without an injected concept resolver remains unchanged.
authority_impact: Exact terminology resolution remains language routing only and cannot establish product applicability or coverage. Product scope is already governed by orchestration identity binding. P1 changes only intent/context sufficiency; authoritative evidence resolution, publication admission, reasoning, claim/payment boundaries and final response safety remain unchanged.
